sql: SELECT n1.id, e1.id, n1.props FROM (SELECT '41064da1-9428-4a9d-b648-b186c5470d46' AS id, 1 AS ord) AS f0 LEFT JOIN anchors s1 ON s1.id = f0.id JOIN anchors e1 ON e1.kind = 'EdgeAnchor' AND ((e1.src = f0.id AND (e1.dst_type IS NULL OR (e1.dst_type = 'Profile' OR e1.dst_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = 'Profile')))) OR (e1.undirected AND (e1.dst = f0.id AND (e1.src_type IS NULL OR (e1.src_type = 'Profile' OR e1.src_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = 'Profile')))))) JOIN anchors n1 ON n1.id = CASE WHEN e1.src = f0.id THEN e1.dst ELSE e1.src END AND n1.kind = 'NodeAnchor' AND (n1.arch_type = 'Profile' OR n1.arch_type IN (SELECT type_name FROM graph_types WHERE ancestor = 'Profile')) ORDER BY f0.ord, e1.seq, e1.id
name: statement/sql/select

sql: SELECT a.id,a.kind,a.arch_type,a.arch_module,a.fingerprint,a.root_id,a.src,a.dst,a.undirected,a.props,'0' AS row_version FROM anchors a WHERE a.id IN ('1d39d78d-9f12-4472-a32c-55a00f563177')
name: statement/sql/select
